case_origin: derived branch-probe fixture from the retained derived Example 3 executable input layout; not a recovered manual deck

transport.molecular_diffusion.provenance: Copied from the Example 3 legacy input; no molecular diffusion.

boundary.upper.code.provenance: Source-branch values from SOLUTE.FOR MatSet: lower -1/0/1; upper -2/-1/0/positive. -2 retains the Example 3 zero gas/Henry coefficients and probes the source endpoint branch only.

boundary.lower.code.provenance: Source-branch values from SOLUTE.FOR MatSet: lower -1/0/1; upper -2/-1/0/positive. -2 retains the Example 3 zero gas/Henry coefficients and probes the source endpoint branch only.

boundary.flow_orientation.provenance: Pinned source water-flux equation at the retained saturated state gives q=-K*CosAlpha; the first completed run confirmed +0.43 cm/hour for CosAlpha=-1.

time.interval.provenance: Copied legacy record layout and non-branch hydraulic/species settings from solute/example3; one 0.1 h interval is selected for this branch probe. Reaction rates are zeroed to isolate transport.
